exposure: Fetal Growth Restriction (FGR) induced by placental underperfusion (partial uteroplacental vessel ligation)
outcome: Labyrinth and junction zone volumes (in placentas)
cohort: Preterm-born rabbits (delivered at gestational day 29) in which fetal growth restriction was experimentally induced.
finding: Experimentally induced fetal growth restriction in preterm-born rabbits was associated with higher perinatal mortality, lower birth and placental weight, and impaired lung function and neurodevelopment.
mod_finding: N/A (all rabbits were delivered by cesarean section, so mode of birth was not a variable in the findings).
birth_weight: Lower birth weight observed in FGR rabbits compared to controls.
gest_age: FGR induced at gestational day 25; delivery occurred at gestational day 29 (preterm).
